summary: Implemented Best-of-5 benchmark mode for the Chrome Dino AI Showdown. Features 5 automated synchronized rounds with deterministic per-round obstacle seeds, speed locking across all 5 rounds, per-round winner determination by higher score with crash handling and draw support, real-time results table (ROUND | DINO 1 SCORE | DINO 2 SCORE | ROUND WINNER | DINO 1 LATENCY | DINO 2 LATENCY | COST), comprehensive final summary with win counts, total score tiebreaking, average/best scores, latencies, total costs, and crashes, along with STOP SERIES and RESET SERIES controls. Single-match mode remains fully intact.
